Joseph Banerjee
Frontend Developer | Delhi NCR
joseph.banerjee750@example.com | +91 9258598560

Results-oriented frontend developer with a focus on building responsive, testable Angular applications. Strong at translating product requirements into performant UI components and improving test coverage through unit and E2E automation. Collaborative team player experienced in Agile delivery and reactive state management.

Experience

Trellis Systems — Aug 2025 - Present
Angular Developer (Remote)
- Implemented feature modules using Angular and RxJS to support a configurable dashboard, reducing component reloads by 40% and improving perceived performance for high-frequency data panels.
- Built reusable form components and validators in Angular and TypeScript, cutting new feature development time by ~25% through consistent patterns and Storybook examples.
- Introduced RxJS-based state streams to replace multiple event emitters, which decreased memory leaks and reduced UI refresh overhead by 30% in large views.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints with product and QA; added unit tests to critical components with Jest, raising component-level coverage from 58% to 82%.

Dream11 — Aug 2024 - Jul 2025
Angular Developer (Onsite)
- Migrated legacy screens to Angular components with TypeScript, improving load times by 20% and enabling mobile-first responsive layouts for live match pages.
- Developed and stabilized end-to-end test suites using Cypress for key user flows (bet placement and wallet), reducing regression defects by 35% during release cycles.
- Wrote comprehensive unit tests with Jest for shared services and pipes, increasing CI gate confidence and decreasing hotfixes post-deploy.
- Leveraged RxJS to implement debounced live-search and real-time odds updates, lowering unnecessary API calls by 50% and improving UX under high concurrency.

Projects
- Live Odds Component: Built a reusable Angular component demonstrating RxJS-driven polling and WebSocket fallbacks to maintain live data feeds for sports odds with test coverage via Jest and E2E validation in Cypress.
- Form Validation Library: Created a small library of Angular validators and async validators in TypeScript used across multiple products to standardize error messages and validation flows.

Skills
Languages: TypeScript, HTML
Frameworks/Tools: Angular, RxJS
Testing: Jest, Cypress
Methodologies: Agile

Education
BBA, Christ University
